data.name: Aishah
data.gender_notes: Aishah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aishah is derived from the Arabic word 'Ayish' which means 'alive' or 'living'. The name Aishah carries the meaning “Alive, living” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aishah usually hope their child will grow to embody alive, living and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aishah is the name of one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). She was known for her knowledge, wisdom and piety.
data.etymology: Aishah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Alive, living.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aishah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عائشة
in_arabic.meaning: تعني الحياة السعيدة والمرضية لله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: عائشة اسم مشتق من الفعل 'عاش' الذي يعني الحياة، وتعني الحياة السعيدة والمرضية لله تعالى. ورد اسم عائشة في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة، وهي زوجة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وأم المؤمنين.

in_urdu.name: عائشہ
in_urdu.meaning: زندگی کی خوشی اور اللہ کی رضا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عائشہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'عاش' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے زندگی کرنا۔ یہ نام زندگی کی خوشی اور اللہ کی رضا کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ عائشہ رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی زوجہ اور ام المؤمنین تھیں۔

in_hindi.name: आइशा
in_hindi.meaning: जीवन की खुशी और ईश्वर की رضा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आइशा नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्दों से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है जीवन जीना। यह नाम जीवन की खुशी और ईश्वर की رضा के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। आइशा रसूल اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم की زوجہ और उम्मत की माँ थीं।

in_pashto.name: عائشې
in_pashto.meaning: د ژوند خوښۍ او د الله رضا
in_pashto.long_meaning: عائشې نوم د عربي ژبې د کلمو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ژوند ژوند کول دي. دا نوم د ژوند خوښۍ او د الله رضا لپاره کارول کیږي. عائشې د رسول الله صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم ښځه او د مومنانو مور وه.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aishah holds deep cultural significance in Islamic tradition because it is associated with one of the most prominent and beloved wives of the Prophet Muhammad PBUH. Aisha bint Abu Bakr was a highly intelligent, scholarly and courageous woman who is renowned for her vast knowledge of Islamic jurisprudence, hadith (sayings of the Prophet PBUH), and biography. Her contributions to the preservation of the Prophet's teachings and the ongoing development of Islamic jurisprudence have left an indelible mark on Islamic civilization and continue to inspire generations of Muslims to this day.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Aishah carries a profound spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the importance of living in accordance with the teachings of Allah and His Messenger Muhammad PBUH. The name Aishah, meaning 'alive' or 'living', encourages Muslims to live in a state of consciousness and commitment to their faith, seeking knowledge, striving towards righteousness, and embracing the blessings of life. It also serves as a reminder of the Prophet's beloved wife, Aisha bint Abu Bakr, whose life embodied wisdom, courage, piety and an unwavering commitment to Allah and His Messenger PBUH. Through her legacy, women and girls named Aishah are encouraged to strive towards excellence, knowledge, and devotion to their faith, leaving a positive impact on society and the world around them.
